method: Every mission solved from engine.create using command/cell/pointer/text/tick inputs; no status/score mutation in walkthroughs. node --test tests/all-game-campaign-expansion.test.js replays each trace from another fresh state and verifies immutable inputs and terminal freeze.
humanDuration: Unmeasured. Solver runtime and tick count are not human playtime estimates.
limitations: Automated solvability/replay cannot establish that a level is fun or optimally paced.
3D is an optional rendering view of the native simulation, not a replacement physics engine.
Original fictional STEM/care scenarios are simplified models; no real medical or laboratory procedures.
